```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

RUN_COLORS = {
    "Marlin": "#ff7f0e",
    "Humming": "#9467bd",
}

DIR_MARLIN = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000"
DIR_HUMMING = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000"


def load_sweep(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    paths = [
        p
        for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
        if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name
    ]
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append(
            {
                "run": label,
                "concurrency": int(d["max_concurrency"]),
                "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
                "duration_s": d["duration"],
                "completed": d["completed"],
                "failed": d["failed"],
                "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
                "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
                "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
                "p90_ttft_ms": d["p90_ttft_ms"],
                "p99_ttft_ms": d["p99_ttft_ms"],
                "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
                "p90_tpot_ms": d["p90_tpot_ms"],
                "p99_tpot_ms": d["p99_tpot_ms"],
                "mean_e2el_ms": d["mean_e2el_ms"],
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)


def read_seed(data_dir: Path) -> str:
    p = data_dir / "seed.txt"
    return p.read_text().strip() if p.exists() else "n/a"


df_marlin = load_sweep(DIR_MARLIN, "Marlin")
df_humming = load_sweep(DIR_HUMMING, "Humming")
both = pd.concat([df_marlin, df_humming], ignore_index=True)

SEED_MARLIN = read_seed(DIR_MARLIN)
SEED_HUMMING = read_seed(DIR_HUMMING)

merged = df_marlin.merge(df_humming, on="concurrency", suffixes=("_marlin", "_humming"))
for col in ("output_throughput", "mean_ttft_ms", "mean_tpot_ms", "mean_e2el_ms"):
    merged[f"ratio_{col}"] = merged[f"{col}_humming"] / merged[f"{col}_marlin"]
    merged[f"pct_{col}"] = (merged[f"ratio_{col}"] - 1.0) * 100

peak_m = df_marlin.loc[df_marlin["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_h = df_humming.loc[df_humming["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
base_m = df_marlin.loc[df_marlin["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_h = df_humming.loc[df_humming["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]


def per_config_table(df):
    show = df[
        [
            "concurrency",
            "num_prompts",
            "duration_s",
            "request_throughput",
            "output_throughput",
            "mean_ttft_ms",
            "mean_tpot_ms",
            "mean_e2el_ms",
        ]
    ].copy()
    show["concurrency"] = show["concurrency"].astype(int)
    show["num_prompts"] = show["num_prompts"].astype(int)
    show["duration_s"] = show["duration_s"].round(1)
    show["request_throughput"] = show["request_throughput"].round(1)
    show["output_throughput"] = show["output_throughput"].round(1)
    show["mean_ttft_ms"] = show["mean_ttft_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_tpot_ms"] = show["mean_tpot_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_e2el_ms"] = (show["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000).round(1)
    show = show.rename(
        columns={
            "concurrency": "C",
            "num_prompts": "prompts",
            "duration_s": "dur (s)",
            "request_throughput": "req/s",
            "output_throughput": "out tok/s",
            "mean_ttft_ms": "TTFT (ms)",
            "mean_tpot_ms": "TPOT (ms)",
            "mean_e2el_ms": "E2E (s)",
        }
    )
    return show.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "C": "{:d}",
            "prompts": "{:d}",
            "dur (s)": "{:.1f}",
            "req/s": "{:.1f}",
            "out tok/s": "{:.1f}",
            "TTFT (ms)": "{:.1f}",
            "TPOT (ms)": "{:.1f}",
            "E2E (s)": "{:.1f}",
        }
    )
```

# Goal

Same **TP8×PP2** recipe layout (`multi_node_tp_pp` on 2×8 H200), same MXFP4 checkpoint and 1000/1000 harness — only `--moe-backend` changes: **marlin** ([published report](https://mnmehta.github.io/kimi-k3/)) vs **humming** (this run).

# Configuration

| | **Marlin** | **Humming** |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Recipe | `pp2` | `pp2-humming` |
| `--moe-backend` | `marlin` | `humming` |
| Parallelism | TP8 × PP2 | TP8 × PP2 |
| GPUs | 16× H200 | 16× H200 |
| `--gpu-memory-utilization` | `0.90` | `0.90` |
| `--max-num-seqs` | `256` | `256` |
| `--max-model-len` | `8192` | `8192` |
| Sweep | C ∈ {1…512}, 1000/1000 | C ∈ {1…512}, 1000/1000 |
| Seed | `{python} SEED_MARLIN` | `{python} SEED_HUMMING` |
| Data | [`conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000) | [`conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000) |

Humming on this image needs the SiTU allowlist patch ([vLLM PR #50510](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50510)); deploy applies/unpatches it via [`scripts/lib/patch_humming_situ.sh`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/blob/main/scripts/lib/patch_humming_situ.sh) when `MOE_BACKEND=humming`.

```{python}
#| label: headline
#| output: asis
print(
    f"- **Marlin peak:** {peak_m['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s @ C={int(peak_m['concurrency'])} "
    f"(C=1: {base_m['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s)\n"
    f"- **Humming peak:** {peak_h['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s @ C={int(peak_h['concurrency'])} "
    f"(C=1: {base_h['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s)\n"
    f"- **Peak ratio (humming/marlin):** "
    f"{peak_h['output_throughput'] / peak_m['output_throughput']:.3f}×"
)
```

# Comparison charts

## Throughput

```{python}
#| label: fig-tok
#| fig-cap: "Output token throughput vs concurrency (Marlin vs Humming)."

fig = px.line(
    both,
    x="concurrency",
    y="output_throughput",
    color="run",
    color_discrete_map=RUN_COLORS,
    markers=True,
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "output_throughput": "out tok/s", "run": ""},
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

## Latency

```{python}
#| label: fig-latency
#| fig-cap: "Mean TTFT (left) and TPOT (right)."

fig = make_subplots(rows=1, cols=2, subplot_titles=("TTFT (ms)", "TPOT (ms)"))
for run, dfx in [("Marlin", df_marlin), ("Humming", df_humming)]:
    color = RUN_COLORS[run]
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_ttft_ms"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=run,
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=True,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_tpot_ms"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=run,
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=2,
    )
for col in (1, 2):
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=col)
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.08), margin=dict(t=50))
fig.show()
```

## Ratio (Humming ÷ Marlin)

```{python}
#| label: fig-ratio
#| fig-cap: "Humming / Marlin ratio by concurrency (1.0 = parity)."

fig = make_subplots(
    rows=1,
    cols=3,
    subplot_titles=("tok/s", "TTFT", "TPOT"),
)
metrics = [
    ("ratio_output_throughput", 1),
    ("ratio_mean_ttft_ms", 2),
    ("ratio_mean_tpot_ms", 3),
]
for col, cidx in metrics:
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=merged["concurrency"],
            y=merged[col],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=col.replace("ratio_", ""),
            line=dict(color="#9467bd"),
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=cidx,
    )
    fig.add_hline(y=1.0, line_dash="dot", line_color="#adb5bd", row=1, col=cidx)
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=cidx)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=50), height=420)
fig.show()
```
